name: Mobile Banking App — as implemented in terraform/azure (Phase 1 scaffold)
_notes: NSGs restrict the data subnet to inbound-443-from-aks-subnet only (see modules/network) — modeled here as the trust-boundary separation itself, since this schema doesn't yet carry per-boundary firewall rules.
api-gateway -> service flows are network-reachable per the NSG rules but have no application-layer authentication (no mTLS/service mesh) — Phase 4 Zero Trust work covers this.

payment-service role scope is 'resource-group' because modules/iam's payments_db_scope currently points at the resource group (no database resource exists yet in this Terraform) — narrow this once the actual data resource is provisioned.
notification-service has no role assignment in modules/iam — it touches no sensitive data (no outgoing flow), so IAM-MISSING-01 correctly doesn't flag it; not fixed because nothing requires fixing.

Phase 9: modules/logging now wires a Log Analytics workspace (log-workspace, in the mgmt boundary) with diagnostic settings from AKS, Key Vault and Storage — closes RR-01. Blob-service-level (StorageRead/Write/Delete) diagnostic logs are a documented follow-up, not yet wired (see docs/phase9-siem-detection.md).

Phase 4 (Zero Trust, RR-02/RR-04): account-service now has its own role, scoped to the Key Vault resource (modules/iam) — closes RR-02. api-gateway -> service traffic is now mutually authenticated via a mesh-wide STRICT Istio PeerAuthentication (modules/mesh) — closes RR-04. (RR-03, account-service -> secrets, was never open on Azure specifically — that flow was already authenticated:true here; only GCP/AWS had it false.) See docs/phase4-zero-trust.md.
